children: Ethan Allen Interiors reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $579.5M and net income of $39.9M, with diluted EPS of $1.56, all down versus the prior year as the company faced weaker contract demand and lower delivered unit volume.
Revenue was $579.5M, compared with $614.6M in the prior year; YoY change (5.7%).
Net income was $39.9M, compared with $51.6M in the prior year; YoY change (22.7%).
Diluted EPS was $1.56, compared with $2.01 in the prior year; YoY change (22.4%).
Consolidated net sales declined about 5.7% in FY 2026, driven by lower contract sales and reduced delivered unit volume.
Wholesale sales weakened (down 7.9%) due to steep contract order declines; retail was relatively steadier with a modest 2.3% decline.
New product introductions and higher average ticket prices helped support margins and improved in‑stock positions.
Operational actions — a leaner cost structure, lower headcount and logistics optimization — contributed to improved gross margin and positive operating cash flow.
The company opened four new company‑operated design centers and continued to operate 11 North American manufacturing facilities, producing roughly 75% of furniture.
